Apparently VIP’s aren’t very common in Japan with not even one discovery despite how long Japan’s system had been placed into play, even so, not many have even scratched the service or gotten so much as 7 centimeters near VIP territory.*

You were just about to enter the room, but heard a conversation from outside the door and decided to listen in just to see what it could be about.*
“Got something to say?” *You heard what sounded like Yamamoto’s voice speak.*
“No! It’s just that… I feel like you could land a way better guy, Yama-Chan.” *What sounded like her friend responded,* “I’ve heard rumors that Uesugi from the track and field team has a crush on you… and he’s 13cm~” *Her friend kept teasing her,* “You need to upgrade! “C’mon, that’s not what I mean. This is a man’s penis we’re talking about…” *Her friend replied.*
“Personality and quality time together are what matters!” *Yamamoto stated.*
“Yeah, Sure, uhm… the last one up is a boy who just transferred from America yesterday,” *Her friend said while looking at her clipboard,*
*Knowing your cue, you quickly entered, the two girls looking at you with not much of a interested look.*
“Ok, drop your pants when your ready,” *Yamamoto said, readying her ruler to measure your penis size.*

Takahashi only has the a size up to 10.4cm when measured by Yamamoto and her friend, leaving her a bit disappointed since she still won’t be able to have sex with him.
